dedupe_keys.name: world data center for geomagnetism copenhagen and the pcn polar cap index dtu space

description: The World Data Center for Geomagnetism Copenhagen, maintained by DTU Space since 2010 and accredited by the ICSU World Data System, distributes through an FTP server the definitive PCN index derived from the Qaanaaq (Thule) geomagnetic observatory in Greenland and the Kp index products derived at the Niemegk observatory. The PC index, endorsed by IAGA, monitors geomagnetic activity over the polar caps: PCN for the northern cap from Qaanaaq at 85 degrees magnetic latitude, under DTU Space's responsibility, and PCS for the southern cap from the Arctic and Antarctic Research Institute. The centre also holds extensive analogue archives on film and microfiche of magnetograms, hourly means, quick-run and pulsation magnetograms, special events, K-indices and Q-indices, with PDF catalogues. It was set up for the International Geophysical Year in 1957 at the Danish Meteorological Institute. Access is free; the PCN index is licensed under CC BY 4.0, and the Kp index and its derivatives by GFZ Potsdam under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the pre-digital archives are analogue only. Coverage is the northern polar cap for PCN, with global Kp. It supports hazard exposure analysis of space weather for power grids, pipelines, satellites and polar communications; related records are the DTU Space magnetic ground stations and the Tromsø Geophysical Observatory data.
